items.correspondence: The old finitely-generated-subfield reduction is struck out. The red replacement says the geometric sections work over an algebraically closed field K and the assembly takes K=overline{k}; it writes k₀:=k solely to preserve the subsequent formulas. items.title: Euler products
items.label: lem:euler
items.correspondence: The original products are false for the displayed Euler operator E=x₁p; the red replacements are the correct falling and rising products. Paper P2 cites the public evaluation identities in Stafford38/Weyl/EulerProductIdentities.lean, together with the existing power-multiplication helper. Both public identities are present at pinned formal source A3.

issues.summary: Both displayed formulas are wrong by a shift for E=x_1p: m=1 gives x_1p=E (paper: E-1) and px_1=E+1 (paper: E). Correct: x^m p^m=prod_{i=0}^{m-1}(E-i), p^m x^m=prod_{i=1}^m(E+i) (= Lean fallingPoly/risingPoly). Induction step silently uses x_1p=E-1. Formulas are proof_map's, valid for E=px. Downstream only disjointness of roots is used, so the section's conclusion survives.
issues.fix: Adopt ALG-02's formulas; end induction with prod_{i=1}^m(E-i)*E; second identity via p f(E)=f(E+1)p and px_1=E+1.
issues.status: open pending review
